items.title: Unit 14 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
Look at my toy, Uncle. His name's Action Boy. Hello. Nice to meet you. Look! He can run.

Look, Tim. Action Boy can fly. Great! Can he play football? Yes, he can.

Look, Rosy. Action Boy can walk. He can run and he can fly. You are clever, Action Boy!

How old are you, Action Boy? Silly Rosy! He can't talk. He's a toy.

What is it? It is a tiger. This is a bird. It is blue, green, red and yellow. It can fly and it can sing. It can't read and write. But it can talk! This animal likes fruit and nuts. It can be a pet in a house. What is it? It is a parrot.

items.why: What does the parrot like? fruit and nuts. Check the detail in “Beautiful animals”.
